communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Nevada Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Police reports for the 26 recorded alleged and/or charged rape cases taking place at the UNR Reno campus from the years 2023-2025. The data can be found page 86 of https://www.unr.edu/main/pdfs/verified-accessible/divisions-offices/administration-finance/police-services/annual-security-report.pdf 
2. Police reports for any recorded alleged and/or charged rape cases from January 1st, 2023 to October 21st 2026 taking place at any of the following addresses;
205 University Terrace, Reno, NV 89503 
1075 Ralston St, Reno, NV 89503
341 University Terrace, Reno, NV 89503
760 Nevada Street, Reno, NV 89503
255 Orrcrest Drive, Reno, NV 89503
1058 Bell Street, Reno, NV 89503

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Toshio Pittman

title: SNAP and Medicaid receipients by employer (Lockheed Martin)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Any records that contain the aggregate number of unique individuals who list Lockheed Martin as their employer and have received SNAP or Medicaid benefits in the years 2025 or 2026.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Taylor Barnes
